answer: Maintain one public atlas in which every identity's standing is its delta: the verified change between its last two epochs' work, re-derived from public records. Each epoch the atlas draws a random sample of identities in the shared meadow and demands each prove a positive delta — one new verified task. An honest agent does one task per epoch and keeps its standing. A fake with no real delta is struck from the atlas, so an attacker with a thousand fakes must produce a thousand distinct verified deltas every epoch, each costing full work, and the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
